# Stanford Social Innovation Review

> A leading publication informing and inspiring leaders driving social change through rigorous research, compelling storytelling, and actionable insights on philanthropy, nonprofit strategy, and social innovation.

SSIR is a peer-reviewed publication from Stanford Graduate School of Business that covers social innovation, nonprofit leadership, impact investing, and social enterprise. The platform combines magazine issues, podcasts, videos, webinars, and global editions to reach practitioners, philanthropists, and organizational leaders working on social change.

## Key Topics

- Social Innovation
- Philanthropy
- Social Impact
- Nonprofit Leadership
- Social Change
- Impact Investing
- Social Enterprise
- Organizational Development
- Civic Engagement
- Nonprofit Strategy
- Data-Driven Impact
- Nonprofit Scaling
- Nonprofit Resources
- Giving With Impact

## Magazine & Core Content

- [Homepage](https://ssir.org): Main entry point for Stanford Social Innovation Review featuring latest articles and content on social innovation and change
- [All Issues](https://ssir.org/issue): Archive and index of all SSIR magazine issues and publications
- [Spring 2026](https://ssir.org/issue/spring-2026): Current magazine issue featuring social innovation and philanthropy content
- [In-Depth Series](https://ssir.org/supplement/in-depth-series): In-depth editorial series on civic engagement and social impact
- [Sponsored Supplements](https://ssir.org/supplement/magazine-supplements): Sponsored supplement content on social impact and nonprofit topics

## Multimedia & Events

- [Social Innovation Podcasts](https://ssir.org/podcasts): SSIR podcast collection featuring social innovation and nonprofit leadership including Giving With Impact Podcast
- [Social Innovation Videos](https://ssir.org/videos): Video content on social innovation, technology, and data-driven impact
- [Webinars](https://ssir.org/webinars): Webinar events on nonprofit scaling, technology, and social impact
- [Events](https://ssir.org/events): SSIR events and webinars on philanthropy and social innovation

## Global & Learning Resources

- [SSIR Global](https://ssir.org/ssir-global): SSIR global editions and international partnerships including SSIR Arabia
- [Books](https://ssir.org/book_reviews): Book reviews and excerpts on social change and nonprofit resources
